title: 一个用户请求为什么会变成七次模型往返

source.harness_execution: real installed CLI launched through PMA exact Capture Proxy
source.upstream: deterministic local Anthropic Messages SSE fixture

audiences: 第一次想看懂 Claude Code 多步任务的用户
需要核对工具调用、任务状态和文件证据的 Harness 使用者
开发自有 Agent 并检查 Anthropic tool_use 与 tool_result 顺序的工程师
teaching_contract.question: 一个用户请求怎样在 Claude Code、远端模型和本地工具之间展开成多次请求，任务状态和文件证据又怎样进入最终回答？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 模型只能返回文本和结构化 tool_use。Claude Code 根据本次请求中的工具定义执行 TaskCreate、TaskUpdate、Read 与 TaskGet，再把结果作为后续用户消息发送给模型。PMA 用 Turn 和 Request 两级导航保留每次往返，并在 History、Message 与协议视图中展示上下文如何逐步增长。
explicit_limits: The real component under test is Claude Code CLI and its request assembly; model replies come from a deterministic local fake upstream.
The scenario demonstrates Claude Code task tools, not EnterPlanMode or ExitPlanMode.
The fake upstream follows a fixed sequence so the public teaching trace can be reproduced; it is not evidence of model quality.
Task status shown in the final CLI footer can lag during terminal rendering; the PMA request evidence and hook log are the facts used by this chapter.
PMA observes the loop and does not create or update Claude Code tasks itself.

setup_turns: 要求建议对应真实文件
experiment.final_request: 只读核对 README.md 和 docs/guide.md：先建立任务清单，逐个读取两个文件，更新任务状态，最后给我三条让新用户更容易理解 PMA 的建议。不要修改任何文件。

facts: The real CLI produced ten Anthropic Messages requests across four PMA user turns.
The final user Turn contains seven model requests, Requests 4 through 10.
Request 4 carries the two TaskCreate tool calls; Request 5 carries their tool_result blocks and the next TaskUpdate calls.
Request 7 carries the README.md Read result; Request 8 carries the docs/guide.md Read result and TaskGet calls.
Request 9 carries TaskGet results with in_progress state and the assistant TaskUpdate calls that set both tasks to completed.
Request 10 Message contains the completed TaskUpdate tool_use blocks together with their tool_result blocks; the final response is produced only after that input is sent.
Request 10 History preserves earlier messages and tool exchanges, while Message isolates the immediately preceding assistant tool calls and current tool results.
The Protocol view preserves Anthropic assistant tool_use and user tool_result roles and source paths for all exchanges.
PMA Metadata shows the deterministic model id, adaptive thinking, max_tokens, stream mode, token statistics, and request composition.
The two public source files retained their pre-run SHA-256 values.

production.audio: not_started; handled by the separate voice-tuning workflow

privacy.paths: Only generic /private/tmp paths for a disposable public demo workspace; no user home directory appears.
privacy.system_prompt: The full request log remains local and ignored. Published frames use only a fictional project and current public tool definitions.
privacy.headers: Authorization and session headers are visibly redacted by PMA.

visual_review.storyboard_result: passed 28 progressive states at both 1920x1080 and 1024x576

review_frames.compact: recording/review-1024/; 28 JPEG frames at 1024x576 plus contact-sheet.jpg

review_notes: Comparison scenes retain the earlier marker when Turn levels, Request levels, tool calls, and results must be read together, but dim it before the new numbered marker appears.
Independent focus changes crossfade the earlier marker into the next marker; the completed state contains only the new marker.
No arrow was needed in this chapter because marker placement and focus boxes establish every relationship without crossing readable content.
Subtitles remain bottom-centered at both review sizes and do not cover the selected tab, highlighted evidence, or final response.

The first production audit found that the directory named review-1920 still contained 1280x720 files. All 28 desktop states were re-rendered in present mode at an exact 1920x1080 viewport, pixel dimensions were verified from image bytes, and both contact sheets were rebuilt.
annotation_policy: Numbered markers are timed teaching beats, not a static legend.
Markers appear one by one with narration; they never enter as a complete 1-2-3-4 set.
The previous marker remains only when the next point needs comparison or a visible causal link.
A retained previous marker uses dim_ms before or when the next marker appears, so it cannot compete with the current teaching beat.
When attention moves to a new independent target, the previous marker fades before or crossfades with the next marker.
Each review point must inspect marker entry, overlap, and exit states, not only the final frame.

remaining: Freeze narration only after the owner reviews the Chinese story.
Do not publish the ignored raw request log or generated video from the main repository.
